title.en: Add leads: one at a time or a whole list
title.hi: Leads add kijiye: ek ek karke ya poori list
title.mr: Leads add kara: ek ek karun kinva poorna list

description.en: Get your leads into Sales X-Ray: add one from any screen with plus, fill details from a pasted message, pick the owner, use the Leads table on a computer, and import a whole list from Excel, a CSV or rows pasted from a sheet.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray mein leads daaliye: kisi bhi screen se plus dabake ek lead, paste kiye message se details, owner chunna, computer pe Leads table, aur Excel, CSV ya sheet se poori list import.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhye leads taka: kuthlyahi screen varun plus dabun ek lead, paste kelelya message madhun details, owner nivadna, computer var Leads table, aani Excel, CSV kinva sheet madhun poorna list import.

text.mr: Leads add kara kahi seconds madhye

title.en: Call a lead and log how it went
title.hi: Lead ko call karo, result log karo
title.mr: Lead la call kara, result log kara

say.en: In this video: getting your leads into Sales X-Ray, one at a time, or a whole list at once.
say.hi: इस video में: Sales X-Ray में leads कैसे डालें, एक एक करके, या पूरी list एक साथ.
say.mr: या video मध्ये: Sales X-Ray मध्ये leads कसे टाकायचे, एक एक करून, किंवा पूर्ण list एकदम.

latn.hi: Is video mein: Sales X-Ray mein leads kaise daalein, ek ek karke, ya poori list ek saath.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye: Sales X-Ray madhye leads kase takayche, ek ek karun, kinva poorna list ekdam.

say.en: Next, call a lead and log how it went.
say.hi: अगले video में: lead को call कीजिए और result log कीजिए.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: lead ला call करा आणि result log करा.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: lead ko call kijiye aur result log kijiye.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: lead la call kara aani result log kara.

text.en: New enquiry? Add it in seconds
text.mr: Navin enquiry? Kahi seconds madhye add

say.en: New enquiry? Add it in seconds.
say.hi: नई enquiry? Seconds में add कीजिए.
say.mr: नवीन enquiry? काही seconds मध्ये add करा.

latn.hi: Nayi enquiry? Seconds mein add kijiye.
latn.mr: Navin enquiry? Kahi seconds madhye add kara.

target.name: Add a lead or a call

say.en: Got a new enquiry? Tap plus, from any screen.
say.hi: नई enquiry आई? किसी भी screen से plus दबाइए.
say.mr: नवीन enquiry आली? कुठल्याही screen वरून plus दाबा.

latn.hi: Nayi enquiry aayi? Kisi bhi screen se plus dabaiye.
latn.mr: Navin enquiry aali? Kuthlyahi screen varun plus daba.

say.en: Tap plus.
say.hi: Plus दबाइए.
say.mr: Plus दाबा.

latn.hi: Plus dabaiye.
latn.mr: Plus daba.

say.en: Then Add lead. A name and a number is all it needs.
say.hi: फिर Add lead. बस नाम और number काफ़ी है.
say.mr: मग Add lead. फक्त नाव आणि number पुरेसा आहे.

latn.hi: Phir Add lead. Bas naam aur number kaafi hai.
latn.mr: Mag Add lead. Fakta naav aani number puresa aahe.

say.en: Type their name, then their phone number.
say.hi: उनका नाम लिखिए, फिर phone number.
say.mr: त्यांचं नाव लिहा, मग phone number.

latn.hi: Unka naam likhiye, phir phone number.
latn.mr: Tyancha naav liha, mag phone number.

actions.text: Hi, this is Rohan Kale from Baner. Looking for a 2 BHK.

say.en: Got their details in a message? Tap Paste a message, paste it in, and tap Fill in.
say.hi: Details किसी message में हैं? Paste a message दबाइए, message paste कीजिए, और Fill in.
say.mr: Details एखाद्या message मध्ये आहेत? Paste a message दाबा, message paste करा, आणि Fill in.

latn.hi: Details kisi message mein hain? Paste a message dabaiye, message paste kijiye, aur Fill in.
latn.mr: Details ekhadya message madhye aahet? Paste a message daba, message paste kara, aani Fill in.

say.en: Or paste their WhatsApp message.
say.hi: या उनका WhatsApp message paste कीजिए.
say.mr: किंवा त्यांचा WhatsApp message paste करा.

latn.hi: Ya unka WhatsApp message paste kijiye.
latn.mr: Kinva tyancha WhatsApp message paste kara.

say.en: More details adds what they're interested in, their city, email or company.
say.hi: More details में डालिए वो किसमें interested हैं, उनका city, email या company.
say.mr: More details मध्ये टाका ते कशात interested आहेत, त्यांचं city, email किंवा company.

latn.hi: More details mein daaliye woh kismein interested hain, unka city, email ya company.
latn.mr: More details madhye taka te kashat interested aahet, tyancha city, email kinva company.

say.en: Choose who handles the lead: you, or the best fit by your team's lead rules.
say.hi: Lead कौन संभालेगा, ये चुनिए: आप, या team के lead rules के हिसाब से best fit.
say.mr: Lead कोण सांभाळणार ते निवडा: तुम्ही, किंवा team च्या lead rules नुसार best fit.

latn.hi: Lead kaun sambhalega, yeh chuniye: aap, ya team ke lead rules ke hisaab se best fit.
latn.mr: Lead kon sambhalnar te nivda: tumhi, kinva team chya lead rules nusar best fit.

say.en: Pick who handles it.
say.hi: कौन संभालेगा, चुनिए.
say.mr: कोण सांभाळणार, निवडा.

latn.hi: Kaun sambhalega, chuniye.
latn.mr: Kon sambhalnar, nivda.

say.en: Tap Add lead, and they're in your list, ready to call.
say.hi: Add lead दबाइए, और वो आपकी list में, call के लिए ready.
say.mr: Add lead दाबा, आणि ते तुमच्या list मध्ये, call साठी ready.

latn.hi: Add lead dabaiye, aur woh aapki list mein, call ke liye ready.
latn.mr: Add lead daba, aani te tumchya list madhye, call saathi ready.

say.en: On a computer, switch Leads to Table. Every lead sits on one line, with their stage, source, next action and last call.
say.hi: Computer पे Leads को Table में switch कीजिए. हर lead एक line में: stage, source, next action और last call.
say.mr: Computer वर Leads Table मध्ये switch करा. प्रत्येक lead एका line मध्ये: stage, source, next action आणि last call.

latn.hi: Computer pe Leads ko Table mein switch kijiye. Har lead ek line mein: stage, source, next action aur last call.
latn.mr: Computer var Leads Table madhye switch kara. Pratyek lead eka line madhye: stage, source, next action aani last call.

say.en: Change a lead's stage, pipeline or owner right in the table, without opening it.
say.hi: Lead का stage, pipeline या owner table में ही बदलिए, lead खोले बिना.
say.mr: Lead चा stage, pipeline किंवा owner table मध्येच बदला, lead न उघडता.

latn.hi: Lead ka stage, pipeline ya owner table mein hi badliye, lead khole bina.
latn.mr: Lead cha stage, pipeline kinva owner table madhyech badla, lead na ughadta.

say.en: Filter by stage, owner or source, save the views you use most, or select several leads to update them together.
say.hi: Stage, owner या source से filter कीजिए, जो views ज़्यादा use होते हैं उन्हें save कीजिए, या कई leads select करके एक साथ update कीजिए.
say.mr: Stage, owner किंवा source ने filter करा, जे views जास्त वापरता ते save करा, किंवा बरेच leads select करून एकदम update करा.

latn.hi: Stage, owner ya source se filter kijiye, jo views zyaada use hote hain unhe save kijiye, ya kai leads select karke ek saath update kijiye.
latn.mr: Stage, owner kinva source ne filter kara, je views jaast vaparta te save kara, kinva bare leads select karun ekdam update kara.

say.en: To add one, type a name and number in the last row, and press Add.
say.hi: एक lead add करना है? आख़िरी row में नाम और number डालिए, और Add दबाइए.
say.mr: एक lead add करायचाय? शेवटच्या row मध्ये नाव आणि number टाका, आणि Add दाबा.

latn.hi: Ek lead add karna hai? Aakhri row mein naam aur number daaliye, aur Add dabaiye.
latn.mr: Ek lead add karaychay? Shevatchya row madhye naav aani number taka, aani Add daba.

say.en: Once your leads are in, Start calling takes you through them, one by one.
say.hi: Leads आ गए? Start calling आपको एक एक करके सब तक ले जाता है.
say.mr: Leads आले? Start calling तुम्हाला एक एक करून सगळ्यांपर्यंत नेतो.

latn.hi: Leads aa gaye? Start calling aapko ek ek karke sab tak le jaata hai.
latn.mr: Leads aale? Start calling tumhala ek ek karun saglyanparyant neto.

say.en: For a whole list, use Add leads at the top, or simply paste rows into the table.
say.hi: पूरी list के लिए ऊपर Add leads use कीजिए, या सीधे table में rows paste कीजिए.
say.mr: पूर्ण list साठी वर Add leads वापरा, किंवा सरळ table मध्ये rows paste करा.

latn.hi: Poori list ke liye upar Add leads use kijiye, ya seedhe table mein rows paste kijiye.
latn.mr: Poorna list saathi var Add leads vapra, kinva saral table madhye rows paste kara.

actions.text:

say.en: Got a whole list in Google Sheets, Excel, or from ChatGPT? Copy the rows and paste them right here.
say.hi: पूरी list Google Sheets, Excel या ChatGPT में है? Rows copy कीजिए और यहीं paste कर दीजिए.
say.mr: पूर्ण list Google Sheets, Excel किंवा ChatGPT मध्ये आहे? Rows copy करा आणि इथेच paste करा.

latn.hi: Poori list Google Sheets, Excel ya ChatGPT mein hai? Rows copy kijiye aur yahin paste kar dijiye.
latn.mr: Poorna list Google Sheets, Excel kinva ChatGPT madhye aahe? Rows copy kara aani ithech paste kara.

say.en: Tap Read rows. Sales X-Ray matches the columns for you, up to two thousand leads at a time.
say.hi: Read rows दबाइए. Sales X-Ray columns खुद match करता है, एक बार में दो हज़ार leads तक.
say.mr: Read rows दाबा. Sales X-Ray columns स्वतः match करतो, एका वेळी दोन हजार leads पर्यंत.

latn.hi: Read rows dabaiye. Sales X-Ray columns khud match karta hai, ek baar mein do hazaar leads tak.
latn.mr: Read rows daba. Sales X-Ray columns swatah match karto, eka veli don hajar leads paryant.

target.text: every column is kept on the lead

say.en: Every column you paste is kept on the lead, so nothing gets lost.
say.hi: जो भी column आप paste करते हैं, वो lead पे save रहता है. कुछ भी miss नहीं होता.
say.mr: जो column तुम्ही paste करता, तो lead वर save राहतो. काहीच miss होत नाही.

latn.hi: Jo bhi column aap paste karte hain, woh lead pe save rehta hai. Kuch bhi miss nahi hota.
latn.mr: Jo column tumhi paste karta, to lead var save rahto. Kaahich miss hot nahi.

say.en: Or drop in an Excel or CSV file. Not sure about the format? Download the sample file.
say.hi: या Excel या CSV file डाल दीजिए. Format पता नहीं? Sample file download कीजिए.
say.mr: किंवा Excel किंवा CSV file टाका. Format माहीत नाही? Sample file download करा.

latn.hi: Ya Excel ya CSV file daal dijiye. Format pata nahi? Sample file download kijiye.
latn.mr: Kinva Excel kinva CSV file taka. Format maahit nahi? Sample file download kara.

say.en: Leads from your Facebook, Instagram and Google ads can come in on their own. Connect them once, in Connected apps.
say.hi: Facebook, Instagram और Google ads के leads अपने आप आ सकते हैं. Connected apps में एक बार connect कीजिए.
say.mr: Facebook, Instagram आणि Google ads चे leads आपोआप येऊ शकतात. Connected apps मध्ये एकदा connect करा.

latn.hi: Facebook, Instagram aur Google ads ke leads apne aap aa sakte hain. Connected apps mein ek baar connect kijiye.
latn.mr: Facebook, Instagram aani Google ads che leads aapoaap yeu shaktat. Connected apps madhye ekda connect kara.
